q: The co-area formula relates integrals of functions on ℝⁿ to integrals over level sets. For a Lipschitz function u: ℝⁿ → ℝ and non-negative measurable g:
exp: Co-area formula: ∫_ℝⁿ g|∇u|dx = ∫_{-∞}^∞ (∫_{u⁻¹(t)} g dℋ^{n-1}) dt. Setting g=1: ∫|∇u|dx = ∫ℋ^{n-1}({u=t})dt — the L¹ norm of the gradient equals the integral of perimeters of level sets. This is a fundamental tool in geometric measure theory and the BV space theory.
